input.summary: Make the mutual 12-month fee cap unrestricted by transaction and carve out confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct alongside the existing Section 8 carve-out.
input.comment: [Playbook] We kept the mutual cap but removed the per-transaction narrowing so it is a true twelve-month fee cap, and added carve-outs so confidentiality breaches, gross negligence and wilful misconduct sit outside the cap alongside the existing Section 8 (indemnification) carve-out.

ops.oldText: EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8 OF THIS AGREEMENT, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER FOR THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE FILING OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION TO WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES.
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8 OF THIS AGREEMENT, LIABILITY FOR BREACH OF SECTION 10 (CONFIDENTIALITY), AND LIABILITY ARISING FROM A PARTY'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE FILING OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION TO WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES.
